project.topic: What are the biggest problems people are facing in 2026 that they urgently need practical solutions for?
project.audience: Everyday people affected by rising costs, economic uncertainty, AI disruption, scams, and rapid changes in technology
project.primary_outcome: Identify the most important problems affecting their finances, work, safety, and daily life in 2026, evaluate practical solutions using reliable evidence, and take specific actions to improve their situation.
